raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-PER-ArequipaColca",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Increased national and subnational political instability could disrupt policy continuity, cause leadership turnover, and hamper long-term commitment to project activities.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish high-level multi-agency Steering and Consultative Committees with formal legal agreements to maintain institutional momentum across political transitions.",
      "evidence": "The slowdown has revealed important structural challenges: low productivity and persistent spatial disparities, in addition to increased political instability in recent years."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "The Regional Government of Arequipa (GORE) lacks prior experience executing World Bank-financed operations, which could lead to administrative delays and non-compliance with Bank policies.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Deploy Grant Facility for Project Preparation (GFPP) funds for intensive PIU training and early capacity building in fiduciary, environmental, and social management.",
      "evidence": "Given the lack of experience of the PIU with World Bank or other multilateral-financed projects, targeted capacity building and training... will be required."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "High institutional fragmentation across multiple sectoral ministries and local subnational governments could lead to coordination bottlenecks and delayed implementation across the 33 sub-projects.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Institutionalize multi-sectoral coordination via the high-level Steering Committee, Consultative Committee, and formal Interinstitutional Agreements with participating municipalities.",
      "evidence": "Efficient budgeting and implementation of investments in tourism are hindered by lack of coordination within a highly fragmented institutional landscape"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Delays in negotiating and executing mandatory Interinstitutional Agreements with participating municipalities could trigger disbursement conditions and halt funding for Components 1 and 2.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Prioritize early technical assistance and legal support to municipalities during early setup to finalize and sign agreements prior to major procurement activities.",
      "evidence": "No withdrawals shall be made... until and unless the Bank has received at least three signed Interinstitutional Agreements"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Severe climate events such as floods, mudslides, and landslides from El Niño phenomena could destroy rural road infrastructure, impair access to tourist corridors, and damage heritage assets.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate climate-resilient engineering standards into road and asset designs, including slope stabilization, enhanced drainage systems, and rapid tourist assistance mechanisms.",
      "evidence": "floods and resulting mudslides weaken transportation infrastructure, road closures impede access to tourism destinations, particularly those most isolated"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "High regional seismic activity poses a threat of structural damage or destruction to historic churches, temples, and archaeological sites during or after restoration works.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Utilize traditional, earthquake-resilient restoration techniques, perform pre-intervention structural engineering assessments, and establish site risk management manuals.",
      "evidence": "The churches were built in the 17th to 19th centuries and are in various states of disrepair, many having suffered earthquake damage."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Elevated road traffic fatality rates in Arequipa could pose safety hazards for local communities and tourists traveling along upgraded rural road networks.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Mandate road safety features in technical designs, including speed calming measures, guardrails, clear signage, pedestrian crossings, and formal road safety audits.",
      "evidence": "In 2024, Arequipa recorded 11.7 road traffic deaths per 100,000 people, a significantly higher rate than Peru's national average"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Bureaucratic delays in national and subnational budget allocation could result in low budget execution rates and hamper financial disbursements.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Initiate budget allocation procedures in GORE Arequipa immediately upon loan signing and codify expedited budget execution steps in the Project Operational Manual.",
      "evidence": "In Peru, initial project implementation phases often experience delays in budget allocation and low budget execution rates"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "PIU unfamiliarity with World Bank financial management guidelines could lead to accounting errors, reporting discrepancies, or delayed financial audits.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Integrate project accounting into the national SIAF system, hire experienced FM specialists, and conduct independent annual external financial audits.",
      "evidence": "Inadequate experience with Bank-financed projects may result in errors in financial records and reporting."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Capacity constraints in GORE’s procurement office could slow down bidding, evaluation, and contracting processes across multiple sub-projects.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide early procurement capacity-building to GORE logistics staff via GFPP support and refine the Project Procurement Strategy Document (PPSD) early.",
      "evidence": "GORE’s Área de Logística (Logistics office)... will be responsible for the project's procurement."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Delays in recruiting or high turnover among key PIU positions (such as FM, environmental/social, and technical coordinators) could disrupt execution continuity.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish clear competitive terms of reference early and enforce legal covenants requiring appointment of key PIU staff within 60 days of effectiveness.",
      "evidence": "Delayed recruitment of FM staff... To manage this risk, terms of reference for all the FM positions... will be prepared"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "High informal employment in Arequipa's tourism sector could impede accurate monitoring and evaluation of job creation and targeted community benefits.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Employ innovative remote sensing methodologies, satellite imagery disaggregation, and targeted household surveys to monitor direct and informal tourism labor dynamics.",
      "evidence": "Measuring the impact of project interventions on jobs is difficult considering the high level of informality, the lack of monitoring of jobs"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Prevalent gender wage gaps, care burdens, and risks of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse / Sexual Harassment (SEA/SH) could suppress women's participation in new economic opportunities.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement a mandatory SEA/SH Action Plan, establish gender-targeted capacity building with local artisan groups, and ensure safe public infrastructure design.",
      "evidence": "Contributors to the gender gap include... exposure to sexual harassment and exploitation risks"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Insufficient private sector interest or investment in complementary services (hotels, transport, tours) could diminish overall project economic returns and MFD objectives.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Utilize the Maximizing Finance for Development (MFD) framework and Obras por Impuestos tax mechanism to structure public-private investment opportunities and promote local business environment reforms.",
      "evidence": "both public and private investment remain low... FDI for tourism in Peru was only US$85m in 2023"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Inadequate long-term funding and operational planning by municipal/regional entities for completed assets could result in rapid physical degradation of roads, water schemes, and visitor centers.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Require approved Operation & Maintenance (O&M) plans and formal institutional budget commitments prior to the physical handover and completion of infrastructure works.",
      "evidence": "the project will support arrangements that ensure mechanisms are in place for the ongoing maintenance and sustainability of the improved assets."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Protracted negotiations or delays in formalizing the Project Operations Manual (POM) between GORE Arequipa and MINCETUR could postpone project effectiveness.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Use GFPP grant resources to draft the Project Operations Manual prior to effectiveness and conduct early joint review sessions between MINCETUR and GORE Arequipa.",
      "evidence": "The Project Operations Manual has been adopted by GORE Arequipa, with the no-objection of MINCETUR in a manner satisfactory to the Bank"
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Increased national and subnational political instability could disrupt policy continuity, cause leadership turnover, and hamper long-term commitment to project activities.
